strings.(오늘 따라 엘리아스의 날씨가 화창한 것 같다.): (The weather in Elias seems especially bright today.)
strings.(햇살에 데워진 따스한 바람이 불어온다...): (A breeze warmed by the sunlight brushes past...)
strings.(엘리아스의 어떤 주택 지붕 위에 있던 한 청년이 지상을 내려다보고 있다: (A young man on the roof of a house in Elias is looking down at the street.)
You're the adventurer the king mentioned.
strings.(청년이 한쪽 입가를 빙긋 올리고 이쪽을 바라본다.): (The young man looks at you, one corner of his mouth curling into a smile.)
strings.(과연... 녀석이 신경을 쓰는 이유를 알겠군.): (I see... Now I understand why he's interested.)
Sorry to call you all the way here. I have a prior engagement, so I can't exactly leave.
You have the mage's ring, right? Let me see it.
strings.(제릴의 손 안에서 반지가 푸른 빛을 발하다 원래대로 돌아온다...): (The ring glows blue in Jeril's hand, then returns to normal...)
There. I've put power into the ring. Now you can add a new enchantment and use it.
strings.무슨 이야기인지 잘 모르겠다고? 난 그냥 반지에 힘을 넣어달라는 부탁을: Don't know what I'm talking about? All I was asked to do was charge the ring. Go ask at the royal palace in Elias.
strings.(제릴이 손가락을 튕기자 푸른 불꽃이 튀어오른다.): (Jeril snaps his fingers, scattering blue sparks.)
strings.(제릴의 것으로 느껴지는 힘…. 그런 힘이 다가오자 어딘가로 이동하는게: (A power that seems to belong to Jeril reaches you... You feel yourself being transported somewhere.)
A plucky little thing. Seems worth looking forward to.
You can stop hiding now. Come out.
So you've finally said goodbye to that hip-hop outfit that never suited you.
strings.얼간이 같으니... 그 꼴은 대체 뭐야? 얼마 남지도 않은 힘으로 뭘 하: You idiot... What happened to you? What have you been doing with what little power you have left?
strings.싸웠다고? 방금 그 꼬맹이랑? ...헤에, 그 정도야? 콜로세움에서 분신: You fought? That kid just now? ...Really? That strong? It wasn't like that when we were playing around with doubles in the Colosseum.
strings.아무튼 하고 싶은 일이 남았으면, 조심하라고. 그 전에 '환원'되거나 하: Anyway, if you still have something you want to do, be careful. If you get “reduced” before then, it'll all be for nothing, won't it?
strings.뭐 좋아. 네놈의 부탁 따위는 안 들어주진 않을 거지만, 끝까지 어울려: Fine, then. It's not as though I'd refuse your request. I'll see this through with you.
Wherever it is, I'll take you there.
Let's go meet the new pinnacle of light.
strings.(가지가 어디서부터 돋아났는지 알 수 없을 정도로 복잡하게 얽혀있다.): (The branches are so intricately tangled that you cannot tell where any of them began.)
strings.(줄기 방향으로 가고자 했지만 몇번이고 방향감각이 헝크러진다.): (You try to head toward the trunk, but lose your bearings again and again.)
strings.(나무의 줄기를 항상 시야에 넣고 움직이기로 했다...): (You decide to keep the trunk in sight as you move...)
strings.(아직까지는 나무 외에 특별히 발견한 것이 없다.): (So far, you haven't found anything unusual besides the tree itself.)
strings.(줄기에 다다를 때까지 이 상태가 지속되면 어떻게 해야 할까... 꼭대기: (What if nothing changes by the time I reach the trunk...? Perhaps I should climb to the top and look down?)
No, I don't think you'll find anything special by looking from up there.
strings.(흑발의 소년이다... 어느새 곁에 다가왔는지 모르겠다.): (A boy with black hair... You have no idea when he came up beside you.)
Oh... I startled you, didn't I? Sorry.
It's my first time talking to someone other than her. I suppose I made a mistake.
strings.(소년은 왠지 흥미진진한 듯 이쪽을 바라본다.): (The boy looks at you with evident fascination.)
strings.역시, 누군지 모르겠는걸!: Just as I thought—I have no idea who you are!
I can tell you're not one of “those who have opened their eyes.”
strings.혹시 넌, 다른 세계에서 온건가?: Are you from another world, perhaps?
strings.그래, 그렇구나...! 역시 세계는 하나가 아니었구나...!: Yes, of course...! So there really is more than one world...!
How fascinating... I wonder if I'll be able to visit another world someday...?
Oh, right. I forgot to introduce myself.
strings.(소년은 싱긋 웃더니 짐짓 엄숙한 목소리로 이야기한다.): (The boy smiles, then adopts a solemn tone.)
strings.미지의 대지에서 방문한 여행자여. 잘 왔네. 나는 아직 눈뜨지 못한 이: Traveler from an unknown land, welcome. I am the guardian of this world, which has yet to awaken... Um... That is...
...Trying to be formal is getting awkward and tiresome. Let's skip it. Is that all right?
You have no idea how happy I am to meet you.
strings.나의 세계는 아직 작고 볼품없지만, 환영하겠어. 네 세계의 이야기를 들려: My world is still small and unremarkable, but you're welcome here. Won't you tell me about yours?
strings.(어딘지 서글픈 눈매로 허공을 바라보고 있다.): (She is gazing into empty space, her eyes tinged with sorrow.)
(The World Tree around her feet seems faded, as though drained of life...)
strings.(멍하던 그녀의 눈이 날카롭게 빛나며 이쪽을 노려본다.): (Her distant eyes suddenly sharpen, fixing you with a glare.)
strings....천둥의 신보다 먼저 눈을 뜰만한 자가 있었... 던가?: ...Was there anyone who could awaken before the god of thunder...?
It doesn't matter. I need only return the soul to flame and the body to frost...
...I'm sorry... You may curse me if you wish.
strings.(그녀의 눈에 반짝임이 보인 것은 착각이었을까?): (Did you imagine the glimmer in her eyes?)
strings.(순식간에 그녀의 그림자가 길어진다 싶더니, 그녀의 모습이 형체를 바꾸어: (In an instant, her shadow lengthens, and her form begins to change...!)
strings.(거대한 흑룡의 발톱이 덮쳐온다!): (The claws of an enormous black dragon descend upon you!)
strings.(흑룡은 날개를 크게 펼쳐 몸을 감싸더니 소녀의 모습으로 돌아온다.): (The black dragon spreads its wings wide, wraps them around its body, and returns to the girl's form.)
strings.그대는... 너무나 강하군요. 오딘의 부하가 아니야. 그렇지요?: You are... so strong. You aren't Odin's servant, are you?
strings.또한 그대에겐 드리워진 '그림자'도, 얽어매인 '실타래'도 보이지 않는군: Nor do I see a “shadow” cast over you, or “threads” binding you.
strings.대체 그대는 누구지요?: Who in the world are you?
strings.(왠지 대답하기가 어렵다...): (For some reason, that is difficult to answer...)
strings.(뭐라고 대답할지 고민하며 일단 이름을 말했다.): (As you search for an answer, you give your name first.)
You are the spark that will ignite Ragnarok in this little world.
I too exist to carry out her will...
I am not the one you must fight.
Your opponent is... this world itself. You must defeat Odin.
Every living thing has a destiny.
Destiny is the framework a consciousness chooses for itself. A way of living.
strings.형태는 다를지언정, 신도 인간도, 들판에 피어나는 들꽃도, 숙명의 무게에: Though their forms differ, a god, a human, and a wildflower blooming in a field bear the same weight of destiny. All live by it, struggle with it, and die.
strings.니이도 그런 거라고 생각했어, 세계수의 악몽, 멸세의 흑룡이니까. 단지: I thought it was the same for you, Nii. The nightmare of the World Tree, the black dragon that ends the world. I merely thought you were a little hasty, when the world hadn't even begun.
In this little world, you alone, Nii, have been fighting for a true mission.
Isn't that right? Black dragon of “Iris.”
strings.나는 오딘, 빛의 왕국 아스가르드를 세우고, 신들을 이끌고, 인간의 스승: I am Odin! The king of light who will build Asgard, lead the gods, and become humanity's teacher!
Whoever Iris may be, I will not surrender this world to its heartless “mother”...!
Nii... I'll give you the real battle you wanted.
strings.(오딘의 몸에서 황금빛 투기가 솟아오른다.): (A golden battle aura surges from Odin's body.)
strings.(대기가 진동하며 휘몰아치기 시작한다...!): (The air trembles and begins to rage...!)
strings.(오딘은 창을 바닥에 꽂고 뒤로 물러난다.): (Odin plants his spear in the ground and steps back.)
strings.(분노에 차 있던 오딘의 표정이 어느덧 허탈하게 변해 있다...): (The anger on his face has given way to emptiness...)
Let's stop... It was only... an outburst, anyway.
Even if you destroy me, this world will not disappear.
And even if I defeat both of you, it will mean nothing.
There is no way to stop the two worlds from colliding.
strings.(오딘은 잠시 그런 니이의 모습을 바라보다 이쪽으로 몸을 돌린다.): (Odin watches her for a moment, then turns toward you.)
There is one thing this world needs in order to awaken fully.
That is <time>. And time is my domain.
For a while, I will keep the world asleep, as it is now.
That should hold off the catastrophe for a time.
strings.그 사이 그대는, 이 세계를 만들어낸 장본인... 이리스를 찾아줬으면 해: In the meantime, I want you to find the one who created this world... Iris.
strings.이리스... 세계의 어머니를...?: Iris... The mother of the world...?
strings.니이, 나는 그대처럼 그녀와 연결된 적이 없어서 모르겠지만, 그녀가 '어: Nii, I have never been connected to her as you have, so I cannot know everything. But I do know that she is no “mother.”
strings.이미 알고 있겠지만, 그녀의 근본은 평범한 인간... 어쩌다 이 우주의: As you already know, at heart she is an ordinary human... A pitiable being who somehow became entangled in the secrets of this universe.
So I doubt that finding her will solve everything.
strings.하지만 하다 못해... 그녀를 소멸시켜 그녀의 꿈을 모두 '없던 것'으로: But at the very least... We could try destroying her, to see whether all her dreams can be made never to have existed.
strings....어차피 나나 니이는 이 세계에 얽매여 있는 몸, 선택은 그대의 몫이: ...In any case, Nii and I are bound to this world. The choice is yours.
strings.자아... 이 세계와 함께 잠이 들고 싶진 않겠지? 그대의 세계로 보내주: Now... You don't want to fall asleep with this world, do you? I'll send you back to your own.
strings.(오딘이 손을 들어 나를 가리키자, 주변의 세계가 뿌연 안개속으로 사라져: (Odin raises a hand toward you, and the world around you fades into a pale mist...)
strings.(오딘의 목소리가 저 멀리서 들려온다.): (Odin's voice reaches you from far away.)
...I thought we could be friends. I never imagined it would come to this...
I'm sorry I grew angry when none of it was your fault. May fortune be with you...
strings....참 놀랍지, 니이. 평범한 인간이 세계 사이를 뛰어넘어 여행하고,: ...It's astonishing, Nii. An ordinary human crossing between worlds and taking part in the fate of the universe.
strings.내가 만들어낼 생각이었던 우리 세계의 인간도, 그런 풍부한 가능성을 가진: Would the humans I had planned to create in our world have possessed such rich possibilities too?
Haha... I wish I could see them with my own eyes, just once...
strings.니이, 앞으로는 어떻게 할 생각이지?: Nii, what will you do now?
strings.만에 하나의 가능성에 걸고, 위그드라실... 세계수를 불태워볼 수도 있겠: We could gamble on the slightest chance and burn Yggdrasil... The World Tree.
strings.수르트의 영역을 강제로 비집어열고, 니플헤임을 흐르는 불의 강을 위그드라: If we forced open Surtr's domain and poured the river of fire flowing through Niflheim onto Yggdrasil, it could be done.
If that is what you want, Nii... I will help you.
No. Even if we did, our world would not disappear.
strings.단지 시작되기도 전에 죽음이 지배하게 된, 폐허가 된 이 세계가, 다른: It would simply become a ruin ruled by death before it had even begun... And then it would collide with the other world.
strings.사실은 당신도 그렇게 생각하고 있잖아?: You think so too, don't you?
By your side... Until the day the world ends... That's where I want to be.
strings....아무것도 할 수 없고, 어디로도 갈 수 없다면, 우리들은 도대체 왜: ...If we can do nothing, and go nowhere, why were we ever born at all...?
It's so empty... Does our life have no meaning... at all...?
There is meaning... Without a doubt... there is.
strings....손님이 많은 날이군. 하지만 냄새가 고약한 들개는 별로 반갑지 않은: ...We have many guests today. But a foul-smelling stray dog is hardly a welcome one.
strings.하핫... 이거 젊은 신께서 기분이 엉망이네. 들개는 좀 너무하잖아? 이: Haha... Our young god is in quite a mood. A stray dog? That's a bit harsh for a wolf as beautiful as this one.
Bear with us. We haven't come to fight.
strings.흐-음. 이거... 아무리 나라도 무지 힘든데. 사실 아가슈라가 다른 세: Hmm. This is... tough, even for me. Honestly, what business does an Agasura have visiting another world? Really...
If we don't return to our own world soon, we'll be “reduced” in an instant.
strings.자... 할 이야기만 하고 돌아가자고, 널 얼마나 지켜줄 수 있을지 장담: Come on... Say what you came to say, then let's go. I can't promise how long I can keep you safe.
Young gods, please hear my friend out for a moment.
A story on which this unlucky gambler has staked everything...
